description: Create a limit buy order — buy a token when price drops to target. Uses ABI-encoded + AES-encrypted computedData.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

amount.description: Native token to spend in raw units (wei/lamports), a positive integer string

lossPercent.description: Stop-loss % below trigger, whole number under 100 (e.g. '25'), '0' to skip

profitPercent.description: Take-profit % above trigger, whole number (e.g. '50'), '0' to skip

triggerPrice.description: USD price at which to trigger the buy (plain decimal)

name: limit_buy
